page_title: VER 0-0 UDI | Verona v Udinese 04/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' The foul by Alexis Sanchez (Udinese) was seen by Federico Dionisi who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
90+1' Arthur Atta (Udinese) gets the ball from a rebound and shoots from long range, but sends the ball high over the crossbar. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Very poor attempt.
90+1' Alexis Sanchez (Udinese) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
88' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.

86' Arthur Atta (Udinese) latches on to a pin-point pass on the edge of the box and slaps the ball towards the top left corner, but the goalkeeper performs an amazing acrobatic dive to deny him. The strike bounces off his gloves and hits the post.
85' Kosta Runjaic decides to make a substitution. Lorenzo Lucca will be replaced by Iker Bravo (Udinese).
82' Federico Dionisi has issued a yellow card to Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona).
82' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Domagoj Bradaric walks off the pitch to be replaced by Flavius Daniliuc (Verona).
82' Substitution. Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona) replaces Tomas Suslov.

81' What a chance that is! Hassane Kamara (Udinese) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes high over the crossbar!
78' Here is a change. Kingsley Ehizibue is going off and Kosta Runjaic gives the last tactical orders to Rui Modesto (Udinese).
78' We are about to witness a substitution. Alexis Sanchez (Udinese) is replacing Jesper Karlstrom.
78' A brilliant individual effort! Florian Thauvin (Udinese) tricks his way past challenges into the box and blazes his shot just a few inches over the top.
76' Arthur Atta (Udinese) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
76' The Udinese players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
74' A substitution has been made. Casper Tengstedt goes off and Reda Belahyane (Verona) comes on.
71' Suat Serdar (Verona) will have to apologise to his teammates after the game for receiving a second yellow card from the referee!
71' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) escapes his marker to connect with a cross and heads towards the left side of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent save to deny him.
69' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
68' Kosta Runjaic prepares a substitution. Martin Payero is replaced by Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese).
68' Substitution. Arthur Atta (Udinese) has come on for Sandi Lovric.
67' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) was in a good position to shoot around the penalty spot after a nice pass, but his effort was unintentionally blocked by one of his teammates.
66' Verona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
65' Razvan Sava reacts well to deny a long-range free kick from Tomas Suslov (Verona) towards the right side of the goal. Verona have been awarded a corner kick.
64' Casper Tengstedt (Verona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
63' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) commits a foul and Federico Dionisi immediately signals a free kick.
62' Suat Serdar (Verona) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
60' Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) makes a good run into the box and unleashes a powerful header in the centre of the box from the corner, but it rises well over the bar.
60' Ondrej Duda (Verona) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
58' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Verona will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
58' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
57' Amin Sarr will be replaced by Daniel Mosquera (Verona).
56' A yellow card for a tackle by Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese). Federico Dionisi doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
56' Udinese have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

55' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom right corner is blocked by Lorenzo Montipo, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. The ball goes behind for a corner. Udinese will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
53' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets underneath the ball and it flies high over the bar.

51' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and produces a low shot that sails towards the middle of a goal. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
48' Casper Tengstedt (Verona) takes a good first touch from the pass, but mishits his shot low towards the middle of the goal and allows the Razvan Sava to make a comfortable save.
47' Federico Dionisi blows his whistle and signals a foul after Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) brought his opponent down.
46' Federico Dionisi blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
43' Federico Dionisi interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Diego Coppola (Verona).
41' The resulting corner from Florian Thauvin (Udinese) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

40' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Lorenzo Montipo to dive and make a save. The ball goes out for a corner. Udinese can continue in their attacking effort.
38' The game is interrupted as Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) is flagged offside.

37' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
37' Daniele Ghilardi (Verona) touches the ball with his hand. Udinese are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
34' The referee gives a yellow card to Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese).
32' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) commits a foul during an attacking move.
29' Suat Serdar (Verona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Federico Dionisi had an easy-decision to make.
28' Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
26' A cross by Florian Thauvin (Udinese) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
24' Ondrej Duda (Verona) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
22' Ondrej Duda (Verona) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Federico Dionisi signals.
20' Ondrej Duda (Verona) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
20' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Tomas Suslov (Verona). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
19' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Ondrej Duda (Verona), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
19' Suat Serdar (Verona) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Verona have been awarded a corner kick.
18' Ondrej Duda (Verona) whips in a cross from the corner, but Razvan Sava is well positioned and punches the ball away.
18' Tomas Suslov (Verona) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play and Verona manage to earn a corner.
16' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
15' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block.
12' The ball rebounds out to Oumar Solet (Udinese) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar.
12' Daniele Ghilardi (Verona) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.

10' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
9' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
8' Lorenzo Montipo displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Florian Thauvin (Udinese) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
6' Ondrej Duda (Verona) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
5' Ondrej Duda (Verona) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

5' Suat Serdar (Verona) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the left post and forces a good save out of Razvan Sava. The ball goes out of play and Verona have been awarded a corner kick.
4' Casper Tengstedt (Verona) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
2' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Lorenzo Montipo has no trouble gathering it.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Udinese will kick-off.
Federico Dionisi will supervise the game today.
